reuse.why: Puts the check in the existing pre-link guard assertBankAccountNotLinked that every provider link function already calls before touching anything.

duplication.why: No duplicated logic; the extra account lookup partly overlaps with the accRow fetch linkBankSyncAccount does later, but that one runs after bank creation so it could not host the check.

placement.why: Correct layer and runs before findOrCreateBank, but the closed-account rule is folded into a function named for the already-linked rule, so its name no longer describes what it guards.

scope.why: A single focused guard, no unrelated edits.

maintainability.why: Small and clear; a separate or renamed guard (e.g. assertCanLinkBankAccount) would make the two rules easier to find.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Goes through the shared pre-link guard used by all providers.

one_place.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked in server/accounts/app.ts, called by every provider's link function (goCardless, simpleFin, pluggy, enableBanking, etc.) before any write or sync.
